title: make_lastz_chains pipeline parameters
description: Pipeline to create chain-formatted pairwise genome alignments.

input_output_options.title: Input / Output options
input_output_options.description: Define genome inputs and the output directory.

reference_genome.description: Path to the target genome. Accepted formats: FASTA (.fa, .fasta) or UCSC .2bit.

query_genome.description: Path to the query genome. Accepted formats: FASTA (.fa, .fasta) or UCSC .2bit.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to --outdir.

force_long_2bit.description: Force the big-genome path regardless of FASTA size: v1 (64-bit) .2bit for the lastz/hspz backends (lastz then reads per-chromosome FASTAs), per-block FASTA CPU commands for the kegalign backend. Intended only for debugging / parity-testing the v1 path on small genomes; leave false for production runs.

zluda.description: Set by -profile zluda; do not set by hand. Runs the KegAlign stages natively against a local ZLUDA build (AMD GPU) instead of in the CUDA container. See assets/tests/ci/zluda_setup.sh.

zluda_mps_stub.description: Set by -profile zluda_mps_stub; do not set by hand. Puts stub nvidia-smi / MPS-daemon / NVML on the GPU task's PATH so the --kegalign_mps_workers plumbing can be exercised where NVIDIA MPS does not exist. Proves nothing about MPS itself.

zluda_cpus.description: CPU ceiling the zluda profile clamps every task to, since the cluster-sized requests do not fit one workstation.

zluda_memory.description: Memory ceiling the zluda profile clamps every task to.

genome_partitioning.title: Genome partitioning
genome_partitioning.description: Parameters controlling how genomes are split into chunks for parallel LASTZ alignment.

seq1_chunk.description: Reference genome chunk size in base pairs.

seq2_chunk.description: Query genome chunk size in base pairs.

seq1_lap.description: Overlap between adjacent target genome chunks (bp).

seq2_lap.description: Overlap between adjacent query genome chunks (bp).

alignment_backend.title: Alignment backend
alignment_backend.description: Selects which pairwise aligner produces the PSL alignments fed to chain building.

aligner.description: Alignment backend. 'lastz' runs CPU LASTZ over partitioned chunks. 'kegalign' runs KegAlign's GPU seeding/HSP-filtering stage followed by CPU LASTZ gapped extension; it requires -profile gpu and does its own partitioning (seq1_chunk / seq2_chunk / seq1_lap / seq2_lap are unused).

kegalign_executor.description: How the KegAlign backend runs its CPU gapped-extension stage. 'batched' runs every KegAlign partition in one Nextflow task through KegAlign's own process pool. 'distributed' fans the partitions out as one Nextflow task each, so they cache, retry and escalate resources independently and can spread across nodes. Both consume the identical KegAlign package. Ignored when --aligner is lastz.

kegalign_mps_workers.description: Number of KegAlign instances run concurrently on the single allocated GPU through the NVIDIA MPS daemon. 1 (default) disables MPS and is byte-for-byte today's single-instance execution. Above 1, both genomes are split into similarly sized chromosome bins (upstream split_input.py, ~200 Mb goal) and bin pairs are aligned concurrently inside one Nextflow GPU task, emitting one KegAlign package per pair. Alignment parameters are unchanged — MPS affects scheduling only. Each instance can use 12-16 GiB of VRAM, so size it to the physical GPU; requires --kegalign_executor batched. Ignored when --aligner is lastz.

lastz_alignment.title: LASTZ alignment
lastz_alignment.description: Scoring parameters for the LASTZ pairwise sequence aligner. Shared by all backends: KegAlign and hspZ forward lastz_k as --hspthresh; LASTZ_SEGMENTED (hspZ CPU stage) and KegAlign LASTZ use L=--gappedthresh, H=--inner, Y=--ydrop. Do not pass lastz_h as hspZ -H — that short flag is --hspthresh, not BLASTZ inner.

lastz_y.description: LASTZ Y parameter (--ydrop): y-drop threshold for gapped extension.

lastz_h.description: LASTZ H parameter (--inner): score threshold for HSPs found during interpolation.

lastz_l.description: LASTZ L parameter (--gappedthresh): score threshold for gapped alignments.

lastz_k.description: LASTZ K parameter (--hspthresh): score threshold for ungapped high-scoring pairs.

lastz_q.description: Optional path to a substitution score matrix file for axtChain (lastz_q / -scoreScheme).

lastz_path.description: Path to the lastz executable (if not in PATH).

axt_to_psl_path.description: Path to the axtToPsl executable (if not in PATH).

chain_building.title: Chain building
chain_building.description: Parameters for converting LASTZ alignments to genome alignment chains.

min_chain_score.description: Minimum chain score threshold for axtChain and chainFilter.

chain_linear_gap.description: Linear gap model to use: 'loose' (default) or 'medium'.

bundle_psl_max_bases.description: Maximum number of bases per PSL bundle for parallel axtChain.

fill_chains.title: Fill chains (optional)
fill_chains.description: Parameters for the optional gap-filling step using RepeatFiller / chain_gap_filler.

skip_fill_unmask.description: Do not unmask (lowercase → uppercase) sequences during gap-filling.

fill_gap_max_size_t.description: Maximum gap size on target side to consider for filling (bp).

fill_gap_max_size_q.description: Maximum gap size on query side to consider for filling (bp).

fill_gap_min_size_t.description: Minimum gap size on target side to consider for filling (bp).

fill_gap_min_size_q.description: Minimum gap size on query side to consider for filling (bp).

fill_lastz_k.description: LASTZ K parameter used during gap filling.

fill_lastz_l.description: LASTZ L parameter used during gap filling.

clean_chains.title: Clean chains (optional)
clean_chains.description: Parameters for the optional chainc step that removes weak/suspicious chains.

clean_chain_parameters.description: Additional parameters passed to chainc (see https://github.com/hillerlab/chainc).

chain_qc.title: Alignment chain QC control (optional)
chain_qc.description: Optional QC measuring annotation feature coverage by the final chains. Skipped entirely when annotation is null.

annotation.description: Path to a BED/GTF/GFF annotation file. When set, CHAINTOOLS_COVERAGE measures how many bases of its features are covered by the final chain alignment blocks.

annotation_side.description: Which chain side the annotation describes.

annotation_feature.description: Which annotation feature type to measure coverage for.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

max_memory.description: Maximum amount of memory that can be requested for any single job.

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs that can be requested for any single job.

max_time.description: Maximum amount of time that can be requested for any single job.
